panels.title: Hourly regional energy (kWh)
panels.description: Aggregate mode: reads continuous aggregate views

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.bucket AS "time",
       c.region AS metric,
       sum(c.sum_energy_kwh) AS "Energy (kWh)"
FROM cagg_hourly_region c
WHERE c.bucket >= '$start_date'::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Kigali'
  AND c.bucket < '$end_date'::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Kigali'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Daily network energy (kWh)
panels.description: Aggregate mode: reads continuous aggregate views

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (c.bucket AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Kigali')::date::text AS day,
       sum(c.sum_energy_kwh) AS "Energy (kWh)"
FROM cagg_15min_region c
WHERE c.bucket >= '$start_date'::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Kigali'
  AND c.bucket < '$end_date'::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Kigali'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Network energy per seven-day period (kWh)
panels.description: Aggregate mode: reads continuous aggregate views

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(DATE '2026-09-01' + 7 * (((c.bucket AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Kigali')::date - DATE '2026-09-01') / 7), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS period_start,
       sum(c.sum_energy_kwh) AS "Energy (kWh)"
FROM cagg_15min_region c
WHERE c.bucket >= '$start_date'::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Kigali'
  AND c.bucket < '$end_date'::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Kigali'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Daily energy for selected meter (kWh)
panels.description: Aggregate mode: reads continuous aggregate views

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (c.bucket AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Kigali')::date::text AS day,
       sum(c.sum_energy_kwh) AS "Energy (kWh)"
FROM cagg_daily_meter c
WHERE c.meter_id = $meter_id
  AND c.bucket >= '$start_date'::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Kigali'
  AND c.bucket < '$end_date'::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Kigali'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Completeness by region (%)
panels.description: Aggregate mode: reads continuous aggregate views

targets.rawSql:
WITH reg AS (SELECT region, count(*) AS meters FROM meters GROUP BY region),
obs AS (
  SELECT c.region, sum(c.reading_count) AS observed
  FROM cagg_15min_region c
  WHERE c.bucket >= '$start_date'::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Kigali'
  AND c.bucket < '$end_date'::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Kigali'
  GROUP BY c.region)
SELECT reg.region,
       100.0 * obs.observed / (reg.meters * (('$end_date'::date - '$start_date'::date) * 96)) AS "Completeness (%)"
FROM reg
JOIN obs ON obs.region = reg.region
ORDER BY reg.region
